title: Touch of Moss
description: A vanilla edits resource pack that enhances the game with fresh texures and fantasy flair!!
body:
# Description
Touch of Moss is a collection of edits to some of the vanilla textures to give the game a breath of fresh air. Aimimng to mantain the vanilla feel with a fantasy flair.

This is a work in progress pack and will recive updats and new features

## Future Updates
- Floura Update: New flowers,crops and foliage!
- GUI Update: Fresh and immersive GUI texturs!
- More to be annouced

## Things to note
I made this pack to use in my Youtube videos but you can use them too!
Please do not redistibute this or future versions of my pack
